### 2026-11-01: Finished my design on everything, uses 2 12v fans to using a mosfet to cool everything down and uses a 11.6 inch screen with a hdmi board to control the screen. This is all encased in a shoebox which

**10h**

Finished my design on everything, uses 2 12v fans to using a mosfet to cool everything down and uses a 11.6 inch screen with a hdmi board to control the screen. This is all encased in a shoebox which and uses a 100mm convex lens to project the image or video onto a wall or screen.  Will make another post as i did more than 15 hours.
